x: "Of four inter-club matches this season our Youths had three wins," writes Junior Secretary Jack Hampshire Snr. "These were over Sutton, Surrey and close rivals Mitcham."
These two have been missed this season and I feel sure they have the very best wishes of the club. Jack Hampshire Snr.

Amongst those standing are Ben Lulham (far left), George Piddington (4th from left), Frank Simmons (6th from left) Jack Hampshire Snr and Charlie Jones (both partly hidden) and Tom Carter (far right).
